FuzzVIPDifferential compile:EK1019/vip02.do-enclosing compiler VIP-2: a program of accepted constructs does not compile: main.vibe 1019: continue cannot leave or hoist out of a do expression. Use let instead of var, and keep break and continue inside the do expression. (line 5: { ev("0"); let sum = 0, seen = 0; outer: for (const x of [1, 2, 3]) { const v = do { seen = x; if (x === 1) continue outer; if (x === 3) break outer; try Effect.succeed(x + 5) }; sum += v }; return sum + seen }); lane del-1
